name: Winter Frontier Fishery
summary: Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point wants Winter Squid for the travel lodge’s meals. The squid are in season along Azshara’s coast.

sections.title: A Meal for the Lodge
sections.body: At Talrendis Point in Azshara, Berdun Cliffbrew wants seafood for the travel lodge. Winter Squid are in season along the coast, and you can bring Berdun ten of them. He admits fishing is not his strength, though cooking is.

faq.q: Who is asking for Winter Squid?
faq.answer: Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point in Azshara wants Winter Squid for the travel lodge.

faq.q: Why does Berdun want Winter Squid?
faq.answer: Berdun wants seafood for the travel lodge, and Winter Squid are in season along Azshara’s coast.

faq.q: Where can I find Winter Squid?
faq.answer: Winter Squid can be fished from the coasts of Azshara.

faq.q: How many Winter Squid does Berdun need?
faq.answer: Berdun asks for ten Winter Squid.

faq.q: Can I get the squid from someone else?
faq.answer: If fishing is not for you, Berdun suggests befriending an angler or paying someone for their goods.
Berdun says he is not much of an angler, but he is a cook.
